zh.title: 会议录音
zh.guide: 写会前笔记，开始录音后查看发言转写与会议总结。
zh.historyLocked: 结束录音后可以切换会议。
zh.deleteHint: 删除后无法恢复。录音、转写、记事本、总结及插件生成的归档文件都会被删除。
zh.meetingBusy: 会议正在使用中，请稍后重试。
zh.invalidTitle: 请输入 1 至 120 个字符的会议名称。
zh.shareHint: 在系统选择器中选择会议标签页或屏幕，并勾选共享音频。
zh.desktopHint: 将录制 Windows 默认播放设备上的声音。
zh.recordingElsewhere: 另一个 DSH 会话正在录音。请在该会话中结束录音。
zh.keeping: 切换侧栏后仍会录音。关闭页面会中断录音。
zh.emptyHint: 开始录音后，每段发言的文字会显示在这里。
zh.listenHint: 说完一句稍作停顿，即可看到转写。
zh.noSpeechHint: 可以回听录音，或在记事本里补充内容。
zh.awaiting: 准备好本地模型后即可补转写。
zh.unclearChinese: 这段中文未识别清楚，可按时间回听原录音。
zh.invalidTranscript: 识别结果不完整，请重试转写。
zh.speakerHint: 编号按声音自动分组。点发言人标签可填写姓名或纠正本段。
zh.allSpeaker: 应用到该发言人的全部语音段
zh.notePlaceholder: 记下讨论要点、决定或待办…
zh.noteFirst: 写下议程或待讨论的问题…
zh.summaryHint: 根据转写和笔记整理会议要点、决定与待办。
zh.summaryPrivacy: 生成时，转写和笔记会发送给 DSH 默认模型。
zh.summaryPending: 仍有语音段等待转写。现在生成将使用已有的文字。
zh.modelNeeded: 准备模型后即可转写。现在也可以录音，语音段会保留供补转写。
zh.modelAbsent: 请在 DSH 插件中启用「语音输入」及 SenseVoice。
zh.modelSize: 首次使用约需下载 241 MB。
zh.alreadyRecording: 当前页面已有会议正在录音，请先结束该录音。
zh.missingAudio: 找不到这段语音的缓存。
zh.noAudio: 当前会议没有已保存的音频。
zh.localSave: 会议保存在当前浏览器中。
zh.storageUpgradeBlocked: 正在升级记事本存储。请刷新仍打开旧版会议录音的窗口，升级后会自动继续。

en.title: Meeting recorder
en.guide: Take notes before recording, follow the transcript and generate meeting minutes.
en.historyLocked: End the recording to switch meetings.
en.deleteHint: This permanently deletes the recording, transcript, notebook, minutes and archive files created by the plugin.
en.meetingBusy: This meeting is in use. Try again shortly.
en.meetingGone: This meeting could not be found.
en.invalidTitle: Enter a meeting name between 1 and 120 characters.
en.shareHint: Choose the meeting tab or screen in the system picker and enable audio sharing.
en.desktopHint: Records audio playing on the default Windows output device.
en.recordingElsewhere: Another DSH session is recording. End the recording in that session.
en.keeping: Recording continues when you switch sidebar tabs. Closing the page interrupts it.
en.emptyHint: Start a recording to see each turn as the speaker pauses.
en.listenHint: Pause after a phrase to see the transcript.
en.noSpeechHint: Play the recording or add details in the notebook.
en.awaiting: Prepare the local model to transcribe queued audio.
en.unclearChinese: Chinese transcription was unclear. Check the recording at this timestamp.
en.speakerHint: Numbers group similar voices. Select a label to add a name or correct this turn.
en.allSpeaker: Apply to all turns from this speaker
en.notePlaceholder: Write down a decision, question or next step…
en.noteFirst: Write an agenda or a question for the meeting…
en.summaryHint: Use the transcript and notebook to capture key points, decisions and actions.
en.summaryPrivacy: Generating minutes sends the transcript and notebook to the default DSH model.
en.summaryPending: Some turns are awaiting transcription. Generating now uses the available text.
en.modelNeeded: Prepare the model to transcribe speech. You can record now and transcribe saved audio later.
en.modelAbsent: Enable Voice input and SenseVoice in DSH plugins.
en.modelSize: The first download is about 241 MB.
en.alreadyRecording: A meeting is already recording in this page. End that recording first.
en.missingAudio: The cached audio for this turn could not be found.
en.noAudio: This meeting has no saved audio.
en.localSave: Meetings are stored in this browser.
en.storageUpgradeBlocked: Upgrading notebook storage. Refresh any open window using the previous recorder to resume automatically.
en.storageError: Meeting storage could not be read
